Summary: Capture individual applicant details and enforce minimum age
Description:
As an applicant, I want to enter my personal and residential details, so that I can apply for an individual savings account digitally.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant is applying, when they provide the application details, then the form captures full name, date of birth, mobile number, email and residential address. 2) Given an applicant's age is being assessed, when the application eligibility is evaluated, then applicants must be 18 or older.
Notes: Mobile and web are in scope. Field-level validation and the precise age-calculation rule are [not stated].

Summary: Verify applicant mobile number using OTP
Description:
As an applicant, I want to verify my mobile number with a one-time passcode, so that my application can proceed with a verified mobile number.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant enters a mobile number, when the system requests mobile verification, then verification uses a one-time passcode. 2) Given an OTP has been issued, when the applicant enters it, then it is valid for 5 minutes. 3) Given an applicant is attempting verification, when they make OTP attempts, then a maximum of 3 attempts is allowed.
Notes: OTP delivery channel and behavior after expiry or the maximum attempts are [not stated].
Source: C section 3 FR-2; C section 3 FR-5

Summary: Collect photo ID and selfie and obtain Veridian KYC decision
Description:
As an applicant, I want to submit a photo ID and selfie for identity verification, so that Veridian can return a KYC decision for my application.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant is completing identity verification, when they reach the KYC step, then they can upload a photo ID and take a selfie. 2) Given the identity data is submitted to Veridian, when Veridian evaluates it, then the result is represented as pass, fail or refer.
Notes: Veridian contract is signed and sandbox is live. Detailed decision handling and outcomes after fail or refer are [not stated].

Summary: Provide live feedback during selfie capture
Description:
As an applicant, I want live feedback while taking my selfie, so that I can adjust the capture before it fails at the end.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant is taking a selfie, when the capture needs adjustment, then the experience can provide live guidance such as “move closer.”
Notes: The complete set of feedback states and capture-quality rules are [not stated].

Summary: Record KYC decisions in a seven-year audit log
Description:
As a Compliance stakeholder, I want every KYC decision recorded in an audit log and retained for seven years, so that KYC outcomes can be audited.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given Veridian returns a KYC result, when the result is pass, fail or refer, then an audit log entry is created for that decision. 2) Given a KYC decision has been logged, when the retention period is applied, then the entry is kept for 7 years.
Notes: Data Platform, Lena Ortiz, is named as owner for the audit log. Required audit-log fields and the retention-start event are [not stated].
Source: B items 1-2; C section 4 owner list

Summary: Route applicants with non-domestic residential addresses to Compliance review
Description:
As a Compliance officer, I want applicants whose residential address is outside the country routed to manual Compliance review before account activation, so that the regulatory requirement is met.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant's residential address is outside the country, when the application reaches the activation decision, then the application is routed to manual Compliance review before the account is activated. 2) Given the applicant falls into this category, when the routing rule is applied, then no exception is made to the Compliance review requirement.
Notes: BLOCKED by conflict with the kickoff goal of zero manual review. The country definition and review workflow are [not stated].

Summary: Require acceptance of terms and privacy notice before submission
Description:
As an applicant, I want to accept the T&Cs and privacy notice before submitting my application, so that I can submit only after acknowledging both notices.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant is preparing to submit an application, when they have not accepted the T&Cs and privacy notice, then they cannot submit. 2) Given an applicant accepts both notices, when they submit the application, then the acceptance prerequisite has been met.
Notes: The exact notice versions and how acceptance is recorded are [not stated].

Summary: Show onboarding progress to the applicant
Description:
As an applicant, I want to see a progress bar during onboarding, so that I can understand my progress through the application.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant is moving through onboarding, when the application experience is displayed, then it includes a progress bar.
Notes: Progress stages and progress calculation are [not stated].

Summary: Save application progress and resume within 14 days
Description:
As an applicant, I want to save my progress and resume my application within 14 days using mobile OTP, so that I can continue without restarting the application.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant has started an application, when they save progress, then they can return to the saved application. 2) Given an applicant returns within 14 days, when they log back in using a mobile OTP, then they can resume the application.
Notes: Handling after the 14-day window and the retention period for abandoned-application data are [not stated].

Summary: Issue an account number after approval
Description:
As an applicant, I want an account number issued when my application is approved, so that I can identify my new savings account.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an application has been approved, when the approval is processed, then an account number is issued.
Notes: The approval criteria and whether account-number issuance occurs before or after funding are [not stated]. The kickoff goal describes the journey as start to funded and usable, while the BRD says account number is issued on approval.

Summary: Fund the approved account and make it usable
Description:
As an applicant, I want to fund my savings account and have it become usable, so that the digital account-opening journey reaches the stated outcome.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an applicant is opening a savings account, when the end-to-end journey is complete, then the intended outcome is an account that is funded and usable.
Notes: BLOCKED / needs confirmation: funding method is TBD, and the steps and definition of “usable” are [not stated]. This story cannot be implemented or fully tested until these decisions are made.

Summary: Send account-opening SMS and welcome-pack email
Description:
As an applicant, I want an SMS when my account is opened and an email containing the welcome pack, so that I receive confirmation and onboarding information.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given an account has been opened, when the opening event occurs, then an SMS is sent to the applicant. 2) Given an account has been opened, when the welcome communication is sent, then an email containing the welcome pack is sent.
Notes: The welcome pack is a PDF and its template is owned by Design, Sanjay Mehta; the template is half done. SMS/email delivery rules, timing beyond “when opened,” and retry behavior are [not stated].

As an applicant, I want the digital account-opening service to be available reliably, so that I can access the application when needed.
Acceptance criteria: 1) Given a calendar month, when service availability is measured, then the system meets the stated target of 99.9% availability per month.
Notes: Availability calculation, exclusions, monitoring method and service boundaries are [not stated].
